n111a7fd796.headline: Brexit deal hope as
n111a7fd796.summary: Despite recent complications, a former UK Minister for Europe claimed Brexit trade talks might conclude without conflict and result in a free trade agreement between the UK and EU.
n111a7fd796.why: The outcome of Brexit trade negotiations affects trade flows, tariffs, and economic relations between the UK and EU, impacting markets and businesses.
n111a7fd796.why_moved: The prospect of a free trade agreement reduces uncertainty, supporting currency and market confidence in the UK and EU.

n678e804743.headline: Loans under state guarantees: Israel compared to other developed countries
n678e804743.summary: Providing businesses with bank loans under state guarantees has become a key measure to combat the economic impact of the coronavirus epidemic in Israel and other developed countries.
n678e804743.why: State-guaranteed loans support business liquidity and economic stability during crises, influencing credit markets and economic recovery.
